user.title: RoomMind
user.description: Set up RoomMind to manage room climate. Rooms are configured in the RoomMind panel after setup.

confirm_restart.title: Restart Home Assistant?
confirm_restart.description: RoomMind {version} has been installed but Home Assistant is still running an older version. Restart to complete the update.

outdoor_unavailable.title: RoomMind: outdoor temperature unavailable
outdoor_unavailable.message:
RoomMind cannot read an outdoor temperature. Thermal model learning is paused for all rooms until a valid source returns.

• Outdoor sensor: `{sensor_id}`
• Weather entity: `{weather_entity}`

Check that the sensor is online or configure a weather entity in Settings → Outdoor.

mold_risk.message: Mold risk in {area_name}: {humidity}% humidity, estimated surface RH {surface_rh}%.

mold_prevention.title: RoomMind: Mold prevention
mold_prevention.message: Mold prevention active in {area_name}: temperature raised by {delta}{unit}.
